# EDUWILLS — AI Quiz Generator for Nigerian Students

EDUWILLS helps Nigerian students learn from books and practice with AI-powered quizzes.

## Key Features
- AI-generated quizzes from books
- Book-focused practice for Nigerian secondary students
- Quiz history and progress tracking
- Learning categories for Primary, Junior Secondary, Senior Secondary and Book Learner users

## How It Works
1. Search for a book
2. Choose your quiz instructions and number of questions
3. Generate a book-focused quiz
4. Review your score and history

## Exam Preparation
EDUWILLS supports study and practice relevant to WAEC, JAMB/UTME and NECO preparation. It is a study tool and is not affiliated with WAEC, JAMB or NECO.
